# Dear ImGui 1.90.1

Dear ImGui by Omar Cornut and contributors, version 1.90.1, MIT license (see LICENSE.txt).
Source: https://github.com/ocornut/imgui, taken from Ubuntu's `imgui_1.90.1+ds.orig.tar.xz`
(sha256 ecce377df0f90b292f15dcbd83d438bddc162b2388c881132bde18c787572a1c).

Only the files the port builds are here: the core (`imgui*.cpp`, `imgui*.h`, `imstb_*.h`) and the SDL2 and
OpenGL 3 backends (`backends/imgui_impl_sdl2.*`, `backends/imgui_impl_opengl3*.*`). The files are unchanged.
The demo window (`imgui_demo.cpp`) is not included.
